title: Lab - Node affinity
description: Prefer and require nodes by label.
scenario: Prefer and require nodes by label. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 2 - Require
tasks.instructions: Create Deployment blue (3x nginx) that may only run on color=blue nodes.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Control plane only
tasks.instructions: Create Deployment red that runs only on control-plane nodes, tolerating their taint.
tasks.solution: # affinity on node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane Exists + matching toleration
